title: Research sprint goal: The tools share one copy of each helper, keep their import direction and stay small enough to work in
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Open questions for this sprint (kb first, then live docs): No outside facts expected: the rules are kb/_self/code.md's (flat prefixed modules behind a CLI facade, import direction); confirm with rag.py pack --root _self and record the lines. No outside facts: the rules are kb/_self/code.md's, confirmed with rag.py pack --root _self (P-efd7537b). Layout: kb/_self/code.md:59 flat modules, no packages; :60 a subsystem is a prefix (ql_, kg_, bench_, mon_, bl_) with its shared ground; :61 a CLI facade keeps the command, a split moves code behind it and leaves commands, output and exit codes as they were. Imports: kb/_self/code.md:67 a module imports the modules below it, a helper never imports its facade, the shared ground (ql_base, kg_base, bench_core) imports no sibling, a stage imports the stages it builds on and never one that builds on it; :68 no cycles at the top level, a reach back up is an import inside the function that needs it; :69 a leading underscore is the module's own, a name two modules need is public; :70 a reader of a format a writing tool also reads is below it. Size: kb/_self/README.md:36 docs record no measurable sizes; kb/_self/git.md:26 kbgit.py holds the command line only.
